defs.meaning: 综述；评论；复习（review 的复数）；复核
回顾；复习（review 的三单形式）；检验

examples.en: Richard Coles reviews all the latest video releases.
examples.zh: 理查德•科尔斯对最近发行的所有录像做了评论。

examples.en: The bad reviews of her new book were very hurtful to her.
examples.zh: 对她的新书的负面评论使她很难过。

examples.en: I clicked on a link and recent reviews of the production came up.
examples.zh: 我点击了一个链接，最近的演出评论就出来了。

synonyms.meaning: 综述；评论；复习（review的复数）；复核
